description: Schedule 13D/13G filings, the disclosure anyone crossing 5% of a company's voting stock must make. A 13D signals possible activist intent; a 13G is a passive large holder. Each record has the issuer, CUSIP, reporting person(s), and exact percent of class. Pass identifier='latest' for the market-wide feed of new >5% stakes, or a ticker for the stakes indexed on that company.

identifier.description: 'latest' for the market-wide >5% feed, or a US ticker (e.g. 'AAPL') for stakes indexed on that company.

name: get_activist
title: Get 13D/13G >5% activist stakes
